title: Streaming re-auth tokens never reach long-lived BRPOP/LISTEN connections in Redis transport
author: PFacheris
body_preview: Related to https://github.com/celery/kombu/pull/2507. When using a `StreamingCredentialProvider` with the Redis transport, the periodic re-auth tokens emitted by the provider never result in an AUTH command being sent on the two long-lived connections that the transport holds: the BRPOP connection and the pubsub/LISTEN connection. title: Deleting failed jobs via the provided view does not remove job results
author: JimNero009
body_preview: Jobs and Results are stored separately in Redis, with the Job ID being the link between them. When clearing failed Jobs, the code iterates one-by-one over these Jobs and calls the delete() method on them.
